# Cornelia Bryant

[Conservative](../codex/factions.md#conservative)

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P17](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0017)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Cornelia Bryant has a fresh, round, pink-and-white face complemented by jolly brown eyes. Her fair hair is styled into a hard little knob and secured with a tight elastic band.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P19](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0019)_

## Personality

Known for her bitter tongue and outspoken opinions, Cornelia Bryant is an inveterate man-hater who frequently abuses and runs down men. Beneath her sharp, critical demeanor lies a kind heart and a self-described lonely soul. She is also a highly skilled needlewoman, recognized locally for her exquisite sewing and embroidery.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P38](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0038), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P22](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0022), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P27](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0027), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P76](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0076), [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P5](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0005), +2 more_

## History

Miss Cornelia Bryant was an only child for eight years before her younger brother was born, and she later raised him after their mother died until he passed away in his twenties. In her youth, she could have chosen among many suitors—including Amos [Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md)—and won first prize for lemon pies ten years prior. Residing at [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor), she frequently visited [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) to sew, drop off news, and express her sharp opinions on religion, townspeople, and men. She formed a close connection with the [Blythe](../character/blythe.md) household, joining them for holidays and offering support through tragic events, such as the loss of Anne's newborn daughter Joyce and the birth of baby James Matthew. Miss Cornelia also shared the tragic history of her friend [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and she initially reacted with anger when [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) proposed a medical operation in [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) for Leslie's husband, [Dick](../character/dick-moore.md). However, she was left utterly shocked upon learning that the man was actually Dick's lookalike cousin George, freeing [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) from her marriage, after which Miss Cornelia urged [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to notify Leslie's suitor [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md). She eventually stunned her friends by announcing her own upcoming marriage to [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall-elliott.md), detailing her wedding plans and lightheartedly exchanging banter with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) about managing a husband.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P1](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P2](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P3](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P5](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P6](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0006), +89 more_

## Quotes

> “I am sure I hope so,” said Miss Cornelia, none too hopefully. “But speaking of the devil, I am positive that Billy Booth is possessed by him now. Have you heard of Billy’s latest performance?”
>
> — Cornelia Bryant — [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P42](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0042)

> “This has been an awful disappointment to me,” sighed Miss Cornelia. “I’ve looked forward to this baby—and I did want it to be a girl, too.”
>
> — Cornelia Bryant — [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P25](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0025)

> "You always look as cool as a cucumber, Anne, dearie. Do I smell cherry pie? If I do, ask me to stay to tea. Haven’t tasted a cherry pie this summer. My cherries have all been stolen by those scamps of Gilman boys from the Glen."
>
> — Cornelia Bryant — [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P12](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0012)

> "There’s a great change come over her lately. She laughs and jokes like a girl, and from her talk I gather she’s here real often."
>
> — Cornelia Bryant — [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P25](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0025)

> "Anne, do you mean to tell me it’s true what I’ve heard—that Dr. Blythe has told Leslie Dick can be cured, and that she is going to take him to Montreal to have him operated on?"
>
> — Cornelia Bryant — [v4 CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES P32](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0032)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--cornelia-bryant.md)

Miss Cornelia Bryant is a visiting neighbor and friend to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). She frequently stops by Anne's home to sew for charity, share local news, and voice her sharp opinions on men and religion. Cornelia takes a close interest in Anne's social circle, confiding in her about [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) Moore's tragic backstory and encouraging [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to pursue a friendship with [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md). The two women regularly spend time together alongside other neighbors and offer support to one another through personal milestones and hardship.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P1](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P2](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P3](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0003), +66 more_

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cornelia-bryant--gilbert-blythe.md)

[Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is a frequent host and friend to Miss Cornelia Bryant. Although she holds outspoken and critical opinions about men, she frequently visits his household to socialize and stay for tea. [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is often amused by her blunt commentary on religion and neighbors, secretly listening and laughing from his office while she talks.

### [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cornelia-bryant--leslie-moore.md)

[Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) is a close acquaintance of Miss Cornelia, who is deeply familiar with Leslie's past hardships and works to help her by arranging a summer boarder. Though protective of [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), Cornelia experiences tension in the relationship when she angrily confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) over a proposed medical surgery for [Dick Moore](../character/dick-moore.md), though she ultimately accepts the outcome. Over time, [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) gently corrects Cornelia's outbursts, and the two continue to share in each other's lives and future plans.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P38](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0038), [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P29](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0029), [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P1](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0001), +36 more_

- Friend of — close acquaintance who gently corrects her outburst  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P38](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0038), [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P29](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0029)</sub>

### [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cornelia-bryant--uncle-jim.md)

[Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md) (Captain Jim) and Miss Cornelia Bryant are long-time local friends who regularly gather at the [Blythe](../character/blythe.md) residence. Their dynamic is defined by lively debates over local news, religion, and neighbors, which entertains those around them. Despite their frequent banter, they collaborate closely on matters involving [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) and share a deep investment in their community's well-being.
